title: Why Do We Yawn?
topic: วิทยาศาสตร์
lines: Everybody yawns. Babies yawn even before **they** are born, and many
animals, such as dogs and cats, yawn too. But why do we do it?
For a long time, people believed that we yawn because our bodies need
more oxygen. Today, many scientists do not agree with **this** idea. In
one experiment, people breathed air with extra oxygen, but they still
yawned as often as before. Some scientists now think that yawning helps
to cool the brain. When we open our mouths wide and take a deep breath,
cool air moves into the head. A brain that is a little cooler may work
better, so we can stay awake and pay attention.
Yawning is also "catching." If you see someone yawn, you will probably
yawn too. Studies show that people yawn more after watching **those** they
know well, like family and friends, than after watching strangers.
